intentions.title: Ship Hundesteder.no — a Norwegian-language editorial guide to dog-friendly places (cafes, parks, beaches, sights) as a standalone Next.js consumer site dogfooding Barkpark as a headless CMS
intentions.evidence: app/layout.tsx sets nb locale, Norwegian OG metadata, custom font stack (Fraunces/Inter Tight/JetBrains Mono); app/page.tsx hero copy 'Hundevennlige steder, fra Oslo til Tromsø'; lib/places.ts fetches from api.barkpark.cloud/w/hundesteder/p/default as the CMS backend.

intentions.title: Give every place a map-first presentation: home page hero map, per-place detail map centred on its pin, OpenStreetMap deep link for directions
intentions.evidence: app/page.tsx renders PlacesMap for all places with a 'map shown on larger screens' hint; app/sted/[slug]/page.tsx renders PlacesMap scoped to the single place at zoom 14 and links out to openstreetmap.org with mlat/mlon.

intentions.title: Provide a browsable, filterable catalog of all places (by city/category) distinct from the curated home-page grid
intentions.evidence: app/steder/page.tsx renders PlacesBrowser with filter copy 'Filtrer på by og kategori for å finne fram', separate from the home page's un-filtered card-grid.

intentions.title: Statically pre-render every place detail page at build time with proper per-page SEO metadata, since the dataset is small
intentions.evidence: generateStaticParams() in app/sted/[slug]/page.tsx enumerates all places for SSG; generateMetadata() derives title/description per place; comment 'the dataset is tiny — 12 docs'.

intentions.title: Never let a CMS/upstream outage crash the site — degrade to an empty, calm state instead
intentions.evidence: lib/places.ts doc comment 'this module NEVER throws'; bpFetch wraps fetch in try/catch returning null on any failure; fetchPlaces() falls back to []; page.tsx and steder/page.tsx both render an 'Ingen steder å vise akkurat nå' empty state.

intentions.title: Normalize permissive/loosely-typed upstream CMS documents into a strict typed Place domain model, dropping unusable records rather than propagating bad data
intentions.evidence: normalizePlace() in lib/places.ts requires a finite non-(0,0) lat/lng or returns null (place undiscoverable on a map otherwise), coerces stringly-typed geo coordinates via coord(), and filters tags/address fields defensively field-by-field.

intentions.title: Keep server-only credentials (Barkpark bearer token) strictly out of the browser bundle while sharing a stable env-var contract across Barkpark-hosted Next.js apps
intentions.evidence: lib/places.ts top-of-file 'server-only' import and comment 'authenticates with a server-only bearer token that must never reach the browser (no NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix)'; canonical env names BARKPARK_API_URL/BARKPARK_TOKEN with fallback to pre-unification names per task dwb-3, referencing templates/DEPLOYING.md.

intentions.title: Present categories with Norwegian-localized labels and consistent iconography across cards, filters, and detail pages
intentions.evidence: lib/categories.ts maps raw English category values (Café, Food hall, Restaurant, Bar, Park, Beach, Sight) to Norwegian labels (Kafé, Mathall, Strand, Severdighet) and to a fixed icon set in public/icons/, with 'paw' as the default fallback.
